question: Do a full SEO audit of https://www.vinnayakk.com: reachability, meta tags, broken links and mobile speed. Then submit a prioritised report.

report.summary: The site is reachable over HTTPS (200, no redirects), has no broken links, and scores 81 on mobile. The biggest problem is page weight: two animated GIF covers make up about 6.9 MB of a 7.4 MB page, which slows LCP (4.2 s). Social sharing tags, canonical and meta description also need work.

findings.issue: Two animated GIF project covers weigh 5.4 MB and 1.4 MB, making the page 7.4 MB in total and delaying load.
findings.fix: Replace the two cover.gif files with short muted autoplay looping MP4/WebM videos (or static WebP posters) and serve those instead.

findings.issue: Mobile LCP is 4.2 s and FCP 2.8 s; the LCP element is a text block, so rendering is being delayed by render-blocking requests.
findings.fix: Defer or async-load the render-blocking CSS/JS requests flagged by Lighthouse, and load the Google Tag Manager script with the Next.js 'lazyOnload' or 'afterInteractive' strategy.

findings.issue: No og:title, og:description or og:image, so shared links have poor previews.
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description and a 1200x630 og:image via the Next.js metadata openGraph field in the root layout.

findings.issue: No canonical link is set, so URL variants could be treated as duplicates.
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://www.vinnayakk.com/"> using the Next.js metadata alternates.canonical field.

findings.issue: Meta description is only 53 characters, which is short and gives little to attract clicks.
findings.fix: Rewrite the description to about 120 characters, e.g. 'Applied AI engineer building generative pipelines and AI tools that make marketing and creative teams faster.'

findings.issue: The only H1 is a greeting ('hello there :)') that contains no descriptive keywords.
findings.fix: Change the H1 to a descriptive phrase such as 'Vinnayakk – Applied AI engineer for marketing and creative teams' and keep the greeting as a subheading.

findings.issue: Unused and legacy JavaScript adds avoidable payload (about 99 KiB unused, 14 KiB legacy).
findings.fix: Dynamically import below-the-fold components with next/dynamic and drop legacy polyfills by setting a modern browserslist target.

not_checked: LinkedIn link returned status 999 (automated checks refused); verify it manually in a browser
Only the homepage was audited; other pages, sitemap.xml and robots.txt were not checked
Real-user Core Web Vitals field data was not available (field_data is null)

output.title: Vinnayakk | Applied AI engineer
output.description: Applied AI engineer for marketing and creative teams.
issues: Missing og:title or og:image (poor social sharing previews)
